description: TmNotionCommentComposer Blazor component in the Notion Editor category.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the composer.

parameters.name: AuthorAvatarUrl
parameters.description: Avatar image. Empty falls back to initials.

parameters.name: AuthorName
parameters.description: Display name used for the avatar initials.

parameters.name: Baseline
parameters.description: Text that does not count as a draft (the auto-inserted quote). Empty for a fresh composer.

parameters.name: Cancel
parameters.description: Raised when the user cancels. Presence of a delegate shows the cancel button.

parameters.name: CancelText
parameters.description: Cancel button label. Rendered only when Cancel has a delegate.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Wrapper class. Defaults to {ClassPrefix}__reply.

parameters.name: ClassPrefix
parameters.description: CSS class prefix of the owning panel (tm-nbcp, tm-ntcp, tm-npcp).

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the composer regardless of its text.

parameters.name: DraftChanged
parameters.description: Raised only when the draft flag flips: the text differs from Baseline. Not raised per keystroke, so the parent thread is not rebuilt while the user types.

parameters.name: Hint
parameters.description: Hint rendered beside the submit button (for example Ctrl+Enter).

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: People provider for @-mentions. Null hides the mention menu.

parameters.name: OnSubmit
parameters.description: Raised on submit with the current text. The parent owns the provider call.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder shown in the empty composer.

parameters.name: ResetToken
parameters.description: Bumped by the parent to apply Value again (clear or reseed).

parameters.name: Rows
parameters.description: Visible rows of the composer.

parameters.name: ShowAvatar
parameters.description: Shows the current user's avatar (or initials) beside the composer.

parameters.name: SubmitText
parameters.description: Submit button label.

parameters.name: Submitting
parameters.description: Disables the composer and the submit button while a send is in flight.

parameters.name: TextChanged
parameters.description: Receives every text change WITHOUT re-rendering the parent (a plain action, not an event callback). The parent stores it so HasUnsavedDraft can be polled.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Seed and reset channel. The composer does not write back on each keystroke — that would re-render the parent thread. The parent sets this to clear or to prefill a quote.
